newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to retreat to around 4,765.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to retreat to around 4,765.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may come off the boil on Monday and a retreat to around 4,765 is possible followed by a flattening out, technical analysts said.
A change of pace began to show late on Friday, when the investment mood turned to one of caution and the FTSE failed to muster strength late in the day.
Even the Dow Jones industrials, which came within a whisker of 7,800, settled for less by finishing at 7,782.04, up 70.57 and this could dampen enthusiasm in London.
By 0725 GMT, at the pre-market open, the FTSE was indicated down 1.4 at 4,781.7.

A little short-term weakness by the FTSE at this stage should not imply the start of any major setback, since there has has been nothing technically to damage the market's uptrend since the start of the month, analysts said.

Short-term oscillators for the FTSE still show a little more upward potential for the index to around 4,810, but against this, there is doubt there is sufficient investor confidence to allow it to stay above that psychological level for too long, they added.
